notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' official sample ballots, all 91 precinct splits. Unlike the other counties, "Where you live" here comes straight from those ballots: a race or issue is shown for a place when it is on at least one of that place's ballots.

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.
